    Transports on block quiver modules #

    On the module P → V of a block quiver, the subspaces supported on a set of positions (blk J) are closed under the transports along letters, with explicit position sets (tr_true_blk, tr_false_blk). Hence every boundary subspace of a half-word is a blk of an explicit set of positions.
